note: What a server streaming a match to a watching client sends to say how long its chunks and key frames run. The header carries zero.

fields.name: text
fields.note: A document in the form a spectator service gives a match's metadata in, to the end of the message; it needs no zero byte to end it. A client takes chunkTimeInterval and keyFrameTimeInterval from it.

fields.name: text
fields.note: A document giving chunkTimeInterval and keyFrameTimeInterval as integers, in milliseconds, to the end of the message; it needs no zero byte to end it. A client takes nothing else from it.

fields.name: text
fields.note: A document giving chunkTimeInterval and keyFrameTimeInterval as integers, to the end of the message; it needs no zero byte to end it.

fields.name: text
fields.note: A JSON object with integer members chunkTimeInterval and keyFrameTimeInterval, in milliseconds, to the end of the message. A server sends both.

revisions.note: A server sends it first, within 30 seconds of the client's request. A client waits on it, and stops taking the stream's messages once the last chunk has arrived.
